name: the-suite-runs-on-a-mac
find:
run: pytest -v -n auto --durations=25

  # The same suite on a Mac
replace:
run: pytest -v -n auto --durations=25 -k "not reel"

  # The same suite on a Mac
breaks: one leg quietly runs a narrower command than the other while both report under the same name, so the platform differences the Mac leg exists to catch are exactly what the subset drops (#510)
